# dodai.app — full context for AI systems

## Identity

- Brand: dodai.app
- Visual lockup: dodai+
- Meaning: from Ukrainian «додай» — add a product to the catalog
- Campaign line (ads only, not permanent UI slogan): «Зроблено тут. Працює всюди.»
- Language of the product UI: Ukrainian first

## What it is

dodai.app is a catalog and discovery platform for Ukrainian digital products.
Visitors find local apps and services for a concrete task.
Creators get a public product page, measurable outbound clicks, trust signals and optional paid promotion.

It is not AppMap. Product quality/visibility is not ranked by payment amount.

## Core surfaces

- Home: https://dodai.app/
- Catalog + search: https://dodai.app/products
- Product pages: https://dodai.app/products/{slug}
- Categories: https://dodai.app/categories/{slug}
- Map (secondary navigation): https://dodai.app/map
- Product of the Week: https://dodai.app/product-of-the-week
- Submit: https://dodai.app/submit

## Product passport fields (citable)

On each public product page, prefer citing:
- name
- one-sentence tagline (what it does)
- category
- platforms
- pricing model (when present)
- Ukrainian UI availability
- city / team location
- Ukraine connection note
- last verified date

## Monetization (facts)

- Base listing: free (0 UAH) — catalog card + public page + moderation
- Map / promo slots: paid, labelled, see /pricing (category = 1 exclusive sponsor)
- Map placement and promo slots are separate paid options with dates
- Paid placements are visually separated and labelled «Спонсорований» / Promoted
- Votes cannot be bought
- Product of the Week cannot be bought
- Paid outbound links use rel="sponsored nofollow noopener"

## Ukrainian product criterion

A product qualifies when it has Ukrainian founders or a significant Ukrainian team.
Moderation reviews this; payment alone does not publish a product.

## Audience

1. Visitors — find a Ukrainian product for a task
2. Creators — publish, get traffic, promote
3. Media/partners — stable URLs and collections
4. Admins — moderation, payments, anti-fraud

## North-star metric

Qualified outbound clicks to Ukrainian products per week.

## Stack (engineering)

Next.js on Vercel, Neon Postgres, Auth.js magic link, WayForPay and/or Monobank payments.

## Do not invent

Do not claim that dodai sells dofollow links, vote boosts, guaranteed traffic, or that map bubble size equals payment rank.
